pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown polygonal regions with high-frequency edge serration and sharp pixel-level transitions. The spatial area of individual patches increases from the lower cervical region toward the central flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily connect three to four paths. Pathway width is variable with jagged boundaries reflecting the adjacent patch margins.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude silhouette formed by the mane along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder against the sky background.
